name: Obstacle-Flag
definition: A bitmask associated with each sub-volume that tracks which neighboring sub-volumes obscure it from the viewpoint, used to determine if a sub-volume is 'combinable' (ready to be rendered/combined).
summary: The Obstacle-Flag is a dynamic job-scheduling mechanism for distributed volume rendering that uses bitmasks to track real-time obscuration, allowing agents to immediately process sub-volumes as neighbors complete.
